comparisons.peer_topic: Completion and consideration of VMware acquisition
comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom completed the acquisition of VMware on November 22, 2023, where stockholders elected to receive a prorated mix of $142.50 cash or 2.52 Broadcom shares per VMware share. Based on these elections, Broadcom paid approximately $30,788 million in cash and issued 544 million shares of common stock valued at $53,398 million.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclosed major business combinations executed in FY 2024 involving significant cash and stock consideration. AMD agreed to acquire ZT Systems for approximately $4.9 billion, consisting of 8,335,852 shares of common stock and $3.4 billion in cash, with additional contingent consideration. Broadcom completed the acquisition of VMware, where stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock valued at $53,398 million, determined by a prorated election mechanism. While both involved large-scale cash and stock exchanges to expand infrastructure capabilities, the specific structures differed: AMD's deal included contingent shares/cash based on conditions, whereas Broadcom's was finalized based on pro-rated shareholder elections for cash versus stock.

sentences.text: On August 17, 2024, the Company entered into an agreement (the Agreement) to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), a provider of AI and general purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale computing companies, in a cash and stock transaction valued at approximately $4.9 billion (the Acquisition).
The aggregate closing consideration payable by the Company consists of 8,335,852 shares of the Company's common stock and $3.4 billion in cash.

Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, each share of VMware common stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the VMware Merger was indirectly converted into the right to receive, at the election of the holder of such share of VMware common stock, either $142.50 in cash or 2.52 shares of Broadcom common stock (on a split adjusted basis).

Based on the VMware stockholders' elections, the VMware stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock with a fair value of $53,398 million.
